{{Top|leg}}
'''Gotagei''' was the God of Age on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]] at the time of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. [[Chief Councilor]] [[Jobath Knox]] became a devotee of the god when he first entered politics.
